name: Latin Percussion Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Kits for Latin Percussion in thirteen styles: salsa, son, mambo, cha-cha-cha, rumba, bossa nova, samba, merengue, bachata, cumbia, reggaeton, Latin jazz and Latin soul. Each kit has a groove in bank A, a variation in B, a sparse breakdown in C and the groove with a fill in D.
